# Petal Chan

> Petal Chan is a privacy-first period and cycle tracker for iPhone and Android. It requires no account and does not upload or sync health and cycle records to a Petal Chan health-data server.

## Canonical pages

- Home: https://petalchan.com/
- Features, Free vs Chan+, pricing, trial, predictions, and medical limits: https://petalchan.com/features/
- Plain-language privacy explanation: https://petalchan.com/privacy/
- Formal Privacy Policy: https://petalchan.com/privacypolicy/
- Creator, origin story, support, and official profiles: https://petalchan.com/about/
- Selected public reviews and posts: https://petalchan.com/reviews/

## Product and creator

- Ayush Mishra is the creator and developer of Petal Chan. He handles product direction, design, development, features, updates, maintenance, and continued evolution.
- Sly originated the initial idea: a cycle tracker where the person using it stayed in control of sensitive information.
- Aman Mishra may appear in storefront developer information because the account is held under his name for administrative reasons. He does not design, develop, operate, or direct Petal Chan.
- “Chan” reflects how Petal should feel: like a trusted friend helping someone understand and care for their body while their personal information stays under their control.

## Free and Chan+

- The free app includes period and flow logging, cycle estimates, basic symptoms, moods, notes, energy, period-product timers, PIN lock, imports, full CSV export, three tracking modes, the period-late helper, cycle and mood visualizers, all six supported languages (English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, and Tagalog), themes, and ordinary notifications.
- Chan+ adds the Advanced Daily Log with symptom severity, LH tests and cervical fluid; BBT logging and graphs; widgets; biometric unlock; app-switcher privacy; food suggestions and notifications; and a BBT visualizer.
- Chan+ is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.
- Every new customer receives a 15-day Chan+ trial.
- Pricing varies by storefront, country, and region. The current local price is shown by the App Store or Google Play.

## Privacy facts

- Health and cycle records are stored locally as JSON using AsyncStorage.
- Health records are not separately encrypted at rest by Petal Chan.
- SecureStore is used for PIN verification and related attempt state, not as the health-record database.
- Android Auto Backup is disabled. Petal Chan has no explicit iOS iCloud-backup exclusion for the health-data storage.
- Production builds do not use PostHog analytics.
- RevenueCat is used for offerings, purchase handling, entitlement checks, validation orchestration, and restores. It receives purchase/entitlement information needed for those functions, not menstrual-cycle history.
- CSV exports are ordinary plaintext files. Once a copy leaves Petal Chan, its privacy depends on the destination selected by the user.

## Estimates and medical limits

- Petal Chan calculates estimates locally using recorded cycle history. BBT, LH test results, and cervical-fluid observations can add context but do not make ovulation or fertility predictions certain.
- Petal Chan is not a medical device, does not provide medical advice, is not intended to diagnose conditions, and must not be used as contraception or to determine “safe days.”
